options.content: Task KPIs and Resiliency metrics require the [HyperPod Training Operator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/sagemaker-eks-operator-install.html). Training Health and Performance metrics require the [SageMaker HyperPod Observability SDK](https://github.com/aws/sagemaker-hyperpod-observability-sdk). For setup and troubleshooting, refer to the [observability user guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/sagemaker-hyperpod-eks-cluster-observability-cluster.html).

Tell us how we can improve your Amazon SageMaker HyperPod observability experience by reporting bugs or submitting feature requests here
https://github.com/aws/amazon-sagemaker-feedback/issues
